canonicalize_license_expression() spells case variants of one LicenseRef identifier after the variant that happens to come last:

```python
from packaging.licenses import canonicalize_license_expression as c
c("licenseref-MIT AND LicenseRef-mit")   # 'LicenseRef-mit AND LicenseRef-mit'
c("LicenseRef-mit OR licenseref-MIT")    # 'LicenseRef-MIT OR LicenseRef-MIT'
```

The output should not depend on what comes later in the expression. Expected: every case variant of the same LicenseRef identifier takes the spelling of its first occurrence (with the prefix written LicenseRef-):

- "licenseref-MIT AND LicenseRef-mit" -> "LicenseRef-MIT AND LicenseRef-MIT"
- "LicenseRef-mit OR licenseref-MIT" -> "LicenseRef-mit OR LicenseRef-mit"
- "(LICENSEREF-Foo OR licenseref-foo) AND MIT AND LicenseRef-FOO" -> "(LicenseRef-Foo OR LicenseRef-Foo) AND MIT AND LicenseRef-Foo"
- "licenseref-public-domain" -> "LicenseRef-public-domain"
